<select id="selectOrganizationVisibleContractNumbers" resultType="java.lang.String">
      SELECT f.contract_no FROM (<include refid="deviceOrganizationFacts" />) f
      <choose><when test="query.grants != null and !query.grants.isEmpty()">
        WHERE <foreach collection="query.grants" item="grant" open="(" close=")" separator=" OR ">
          (f.company_id=#{grant.companyId}
          <if test="grant.departmentId != null">
            AND (f.department_id=#{grant.departmentId}
              <if test="grant.departmentCode != null and grant.departmentCode != ''">OR CAST(f.department_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{grant.departmentCode} AS BINARY)</if>)
          </if>)
        </foreach>
      </when><otherwise>WHERE 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    </select>

<select id="selectDeviceOrganizations" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.commerce.api.scope.ContractDeviceVisibilityApi$Organization">
      SELECT f.contract_no,f.company_id,f.company_name,f.department_id,f.department_code,f.department_name
      FROM (<include refid="deviceOrganizationFacts" />) f
      <choose><when test="query.contractNumbers != null and !query.contractNumbers.isEmpty()">
        WHERE f.contract_no IN <foreach collection="query.contractNumbers" item="number" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{number}</foreach>
      </when><otherwise>WHERE 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    </select>

<select id="selectVisibleDeviceContractNumbers" resultType="java.lang.String">
        SELECT c.contract_no
        FROM com_contract c
        JOIN (SELECT contract_no FROM com_contract
              WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = 0
              <include refid="deviceContractCandidates" />
              GROUP BY contract_no HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) unique_number
          ON unique_number.contract_no = c.contract_no
        WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0
          AND c.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND c.contract_no <> ''
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_shipment_contract_reference shipment
              WHERE shipment.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND shipment.deleted=0 AND shipment.contract_no=c.contract_no
                AND (shipment.company_code IS NULL OR shipment.company_code=''
                  OR CAST(shipment.company_code AS BINARY) <> CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)))
        <choose>
          <when test="(query.companyCodes != null and !query.companyCodes.isEmpty()) or (query.projectIds != null and !query.projectIds.isEmpty())">
          AND (
          <if test="query.companyCodes != null and query.companyCodes.size() > 0">
            CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY) IN
            <foreach collection="query.companyCodes" item="companyCode" open="(" separator="," close=")">CAST(#{companyCode} AS BINARY)</foreach>
          </if>
          <if test="query.companyCodes != null and query.companyCodes.size() > 0 and query.projectIds != null and query.projectIds.size() > 0"> OR </if>
          <if test="query.projectIds != null and query.projectIds.size() > 0">
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation pcr
                    WHERE pcr.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND pcr.contract_id = c.id
                      AND pcr.deleted = 0 AND pcr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pcr.effective_to IS NULL
                      AND pcr.project_id IN
                      <foreach collection="query.projectIds" item="projectId" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{projectId}</foreach>)
          </if>
          )
          </when>
          <otherwise>AND 1 = 0</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </select>

<select id="selectByCompanyScope" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.commerce.dal.dataobject.contract.ContractDO">
        SELECT c.*
        FROM com_contract c
        WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND c.deleted = 0
          <include refid="rootReadScope" />
        <if test="query.contractNo != null and query.contractNo != ''">
          AND contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractNo}, '%')
        </if>
        <if test="query.companyCode != null and query.companyCode != ''">
          AND CAST(company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(#{query.companyCode} AS BINARY)
        </if>
        <if test="query.contractType != null and query.contractType != ''">
          AND contract_type = #{query.contractType}
        </if>
        <if test="query.customerKeyword != null and query.customerKeyword != ''">
          AND (customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.customerKeyword}, '%')
            OR customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.customerKeyword}, '%'))

        <if test="query.sourceSystem != null and query.sourceSystem != ''">
          AND master_source_system = #{query.sourceSystem}
        </if>
        <if test="query.status != null and query.status != ''">
          AND status = #{query.status}
        </if>
        ORDER BY c.contract_no, c.id
        LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.limit}
    </select>

<insert id="insertHistorical">
        INSERT INTO com_project_contract_relation
        (id,tenant_id,project_id,contract_id,relation_role,source_system,source_table,source_record_key,
         effective_from,effective_to,status,version,creator,create_time,updater,update_time,deleted)
        VALUES (#{row.id},#{row.tenantId},#{row.projectId},#{row.contractId},#{row.relationRole},#{row.sourceSystem},
                #{row.sourceTable},#{row.sourceRecordKey},#{row.effectiveFrom},#{row.effectiveTo},#{row.status},
                #{row.version},#{row.creator},#{row.createTime},#{row.updater},#{row.updateTime},#{row.deleted})
    </insert>

<update id="correctHistorical">
        UPDATE com_project_contract_relation
        SET creator=#{write.after.creator}, create_time=#{write.after.createTime},
            updater=#{write.after.updater}, update_time=#{write.after.updateTime},
            effective_from=#{write.after.effectiveFrom}, version=#{write.after.version}
        WHERE tenant_id=#{write.before.tenantId} AND id=#{write.before.id} AND version=#{write.before.version}
          AND deleted=0
    </update>

<update id="restoreWithdrawn">
        UPDATE com_project_contract_relation
        SET deleted=0, version=#{write.after.version}, update_time=update_time
        WHERE tenant_id=#{write.before.tenantId} AND id=#{write.before.id}
          AND version=#{write.before.version} AND deleted=1
    </update>

<select id="selectIdentitySources" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT b.* FROM int_sync_binding b
    JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE
    WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE
      AND t.source_system=#{query.sourceSystem} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId}
      AND (t.adapter=#{query.adapter}
        <if test="query.originalOnly and query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION' AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info') AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')</if>
        <if test="!query.originalOnly">
        <choose>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP_DIRECT' AND b.object_key='DEVICE_BASE' AND b.source_object='ast_device_shipment')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('pm_project_header','pm_project_identity'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ORGANIZATION'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ORGANIZATION_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('COMPANY','DEPARTMENT','fnd_department','ehr_department','COMPANY_REFERENCE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info')
                AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_ROLE','FND_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_USER_ROLE','FND_USER_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_SCOPES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user_info','fnd_user_info','fnd_user_power')
                AND b.source_key LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
        </choose>
        </if>
      ) AND b.source_object=#{query.sourceObject}
    <choose>
      <when test="query.sourceKeys != null and !query.sourceKeys.isEmpty()">
        AND b.source_key IN
        <foreach collection="query.sourceKeys" item="key" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{key}</foreach>
      </when>
      <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
    </choose>
    ORDER BY b.id
  </select>

      +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND parent_id=#{query.projectId})
  </select>

<select id="selectVisiblePage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMasterDO">
        SELECT p.*
        FROM proj_project p
        WHERE p.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND p.deleted = b'0'
          AND p.id IN
          <foreach collection="query.visibleProjectIds" item="projectId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
              #{projectId}
          </foreach>
          <if test="query.projectNameKeyword != null and query.projectNameKeyword != ''">
              AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.projectNameKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCodePrefix != null and query.projectCodePrefix != ''">
              AND p.project_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.projectCodePrefix}, '%')
          </if>
          <choose>
              <when test="query.status != null and query.status != '' and query.status.matches('S[0-6]')">
                  AND p.current_stage = #{query.status}
                  AND p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
              </when>
              <otherwise>
                  <if test="query.status != null and query.status != ''">
                      AND p.lifecycle_status = #{query.status}
                  </if>
              </otherwise>
          </choose>
          <if test="query.signingMethod != null and query.signingMethod != ''">
              AND p.signing_method = #{query.signingMethod}
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCategory != null and query.projectCategory != ''">
              AND p.project_category = #{query.projectCategory}
          </if>
          <if test="query.implementationMode != null and query.implementationMode != ''">
              AND p.implementation_mode = #{query.implementationMode}
          </if>
          <if test="query.majorProjectLevel != null and query.majorProjectLevel != ''">
              AND p.major_project_level = #{query.majorProjectLevel}
          </if>
          <if test="query.contractNoKeyword != null and query.contractNoKeyword != ''">
              AND p.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractNoKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.departmentId != null">
              AND p.department_id = #{query.departmentId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.companyId != null">
              AND p.company_id = #{query.companyId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeStart != null">
              AND p.create_time >= #{query.createTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.create_time < #{query.createTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_close_time >= #{query.closeTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_close_time < #{query.closeTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time >= #{query.refreshTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time < #{query.refreshTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != null and query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != ''">
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_party pp
                  WHERE pp.project_id = p.id
                    AND pp.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                    AND pp.deleted = b'0'
                    AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'
                    AND (pp.effective_from IS NULL OR pp.effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND (pp.effective_to IS NULL OR pp.effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND pp.party_role IN ('AGENT', 'SERVICE_PROVIDER')
                    AND (pp.party_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%')
                      OR pp.party_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%'))
              )
          </if>
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
    </select>

<select id="selectCurrentResponsibilityForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMemberAssignmentDO">
        SELECT *
        FROM proj_project_member_assignment
        WHERE project_id = #{query.projectId}

          AND deleted = b'0'
          AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})

        FROM proj_project_member_assignment
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND project_id = #{query.projectId}
          <if test="query.subjectUserId != null">
              AND user_id = #{query.subjectUserId}

          AND deleted = b'0'
          AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})
          AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})
        ORDER BY user_id, member_role, id
